review_type: Independent manual textual audit; qualitative judgments, not an official IELTS regrade
source: results/run_data.json; 8f7be6c7, prompt iwa-2026-11-04.4; seven synthetic samples, six Task 2
scope: All six final Task 2 argument maps were read against the original essay and transport prompt. No model calls or external-source verification.

strong_self_conflict.conclusion_paragraph_comment: 结论与立场一致，无新论点，但基本复述前文，未整合让步条件。
strong_self_conflict.problem_comment: 结论未纳入让步段承认的农村与货运例外，使立场表述比引言更绝对，前后略有落差。

automated_facts.underlength_mapping_note: Original is one physical paragraph, but model returns five paragraph entries for sentence roles; the rubric summary itself acknowledges one paragraph. This affects displayed paragraph interpretation/counts, not quote existence.

manual_findings.finding: 部分同意被判成偏离和前后矛盾

model_problems.label: 分论点偏离立场或题目
model_problems.quote: Secondly, new road is also important.
model_problems.comment: 整段为修路辩护，与“优先公共交通”的主立场相冲突，且未作让步后回扣。
model_problems.suggestion: 把该段改为让步段，先承认修路作用，再说明为何公共交通仍应优先。

model_problems.label: 结尾与立场不一致
model_problems.quote: Both is important for the people and the country develop.
model_problems.comment: 结论同时肯定双方，与“公共交通更重要”的主立场不一致。
model_problems.suggestion: 结论只重申主立场，并说明修路是有限补充。

original_evidence: I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.
But I think public transport is more important than road.
In conclusion, I think goverment should spend more money for public transport but also build some road when it is necessary.
manual_findings.reason: 原文从部分同意到公交优先、必要时修路的结论相容。支持必要道路并不否定公交优先；最后Both is important也不等于两者同等优先。模型截取末句而忽略前一句的优先次序，把可改善的表达清晰度升级为论点冲突。

manual_findings.finding: 立场表述可更明确，但不能据此认定不一致

model_problems.label: 立场不清或前后不一致
model_problems.quote: I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.
model_problems.comment: 开头没有明确同意程度，全文立场不清晰。
model_problems.suggestion: 用一句话明确立场，如：I largely agree, though roads should not be ignored entirely.

original_evidence: I am agree with this opinion in some way but not all.
But I think public transport is more important than road.
manual_findings.reason: 开头some way but not all较笼统，明确程度是合理建议；但position.consistent=false以及全文摇摆的判断没有得到全文支持。unclear_position合并清晰度与一致性，掩盖这一区别。

manual_findings.finding: 通勤例子存在回扣，但不能独自证明扩路是解决方式

model_problems.label: 例子没有回扣论点
model_problems.quote: For example my father drive to work everyday and he spend two hour in the road.
model_problems.comment: 例子只陈述事实，没有说明它如何证明“需要修路”。
model_problems.suggestion: 加一句结果回扣：This wasted time shows why some new roads are still needed.

original_evidence: If there is no new road the traffic jam will be very bad and people waste a lot of time.
For example my father drive to work everyday and he spend two hour in the road.
This is very bad for him and for the economy also.
manual_findings.reason: 例子前有拥堵浪费时间，后有个人和经济后果，不能说只提及事实而完全没有回扣。合理的改进点是解释为什么在该情境下需要道路而不是公交，而非机械追加一个结果句。

manual_findings.finding: 限定范围的让步不必被推翻

model_problems.label: 让步后没有反驳
model_problems.quote: On the other hand, new roads are sometimes needed.
model_problems.comment: 让步段只陈述修路的必要性，没有说明为何这仍不改变'优先投资公交'的总体立场，让步未被回应。
model_problems.suggestion: 在让步段末尾加一句回扣，如："Nevertheless, these cases are limited, and in most urban areas public transport remains the more cost-effective priority."

original_evidence: I mostly agree with this view, although I believe some road building is still necessary.
In rural areas, there are not enough passengers to make train lines profitable, so people depend on cars.
However, they should still build roads in places where public transport is not practical.
manual_findings.reason: 道路必要性是开头限定立场的一部分，农村公交不适用的理由已与末段例外对应。增加段尾衔接可改善流畅度，但把没有逐段反驳当作论证缺陷，可能迫使作者反驳自己的合法例外。

manual_findings.finding: 环境理由可以展开，但并非毫无机制

model_problems.label: 论点缺少解释或支撑
model_problems.quote: Public transport produces less pollution per passenger, so it is a more sustainable option in the long term.
model_problems.comment: 环境论点只有概括性说明，缺少具体机制或例证，属于未充分展开的断言。
model_problems.suggestion: 补充具体例证或数据化对比，如："A full bus can cut emissions per person by over 80% compared with the same number of cars."

original_evidence: Cars produce a lot of air pollution and carbon emissions, which are harmful to people's health and contribute to climate change.
Public transport produces less pollution per passenger, so it is a more sustainable option in the long term.
manual_findings.reason: 现有说明较短，补充分流和人均排放原因有价值；但理由已有污染、健康与可持续性因果关系，不宜因缺少数字例证就认定没有支撑。建议中的80%数字没有出现在原文，且本次未核实其外部真实性。

manual_findings.finding: 要求具体例证是提升建议，不是没有论证

model_problems.label: 论点缺少解释或支撑
model_problems.quote: there is considerable evidence that new roads tend to fill up quickly
model_problems.comment: 声称有大量证据却未给出任何具体来源或实例，属于未充分展开的断言。
model_problems.suggestion: 补一个具体城市或研究实例，说明新路建成后车流量在多长时间内回升。

original_evidence: Moreover, there is considerable evidence that new roads tend to fill up quickly, as cheaper and faster journeys encourage more people to drive.
Expanding road networks may therefore offer only temporary relief before congestion returns.
manual_findings.reason: considerable evidence没有给出具体例子可被建议改写，但as引出的诱导需求机制和therefore结果都已经存在；不能把具体案例作为唯一可接受的支撑。

manual_findings.finding: 气候目标句不是一个未回扣的例子

model_problems.label: 例子没有回扣论点
model_problems.quote: which is increasingly important as cities attempt to meet climate targets
model_problems.comment: 提到气候目标但未说明公共交通如何具体贡献，例子/机制没有回扣到减排主张。
model_problems.suggestion: 加一句量化说明，如一辆满载公交可替代数十辆私家车，从而把减排机制与主张连接起来。

original_evidence: At the same time, shifting journeys from cars to trains and buses reduces both air pollution and greenhouse gas emissions, which is increasingly important as cities attempt to meet climate targets.
manual_findings.reason: 完整句已将出行方式转移、污染/排放下降与气候目标连接。模型只引用which从句并标为example_not_linked，忽略前半句的作用；可增加细节，但当前分类和缺机制结论不准确。

manual_findings.finding: 推理链已有，具体城市案例只是可选增强

model_problems.label: 论点缺少解释或支撑
model_problems.quote: This phenomenon, often described as induced demand, means that road building can become an expensive treadmill.
model_problems.comment: 以 'experience from many large cities' 概括代替具体例证，支撑停留在推理层面。
model_problems.suggestion: 补一个具体城市案例及结果，如洛杉矶 405 号公路扩建后拥堵迅速回升。

original_evidence: Yet experience from many large cities suggests otherwise: widening a motorway lowers the cost of driving, which in turn draws additional traffic until the new lanes are as clogged as the old ones.
This phenomenon, often described as induced demand, means that road building can become an expensive treadmill.
manual_findings.reason: 原文明确给出扩路降低开车成本、吸引车流、新路再次拥堵的机制与结果。添加具体案例可增强表达，但以缺城市名称为由标为unsupported夸大了缺陷。没有教师评分基准，不能据此重新估计应得分数。

manual_findings.finding: 步行社区被错误描述为没有机制或结果

model_problems.label: 论点缺少解释或支撑
model_problems.quote: Well-designed transit also allows denser, more walkable neighbourhoods to develop around stations, reducing the distances people need to travel in the first place, and it cuts emissions
model_problems.comment: 步行社区与减排两个论点仅被提及，未解释机制或给出结果。
model_problems.suggestion: 拆句并各给一个简短机制或实例，说明车站周边如何形成高密度开发、进而减少出行距离与排放。

original_evidence: Well-designed transit also allows denser, more walkable neighbourhoods to develop around stations, reducing the distances people need to travel in the first place, and it cuts emissions at a time when the transport sector remains one of the most stubborn sources of carbon.
manual_findings.reason: 原句已经有车站周边密集可步行社区→出行距离减少的机制/结果。减排环节还可进一步解释，也可拆长句；但评论说两个论点仅被提及、未解释机制或给出结果，与原句不符。

manual_findings.finding: 结尾限定程度与开头相容，模型自身判断矛盾

model_problems.label: 结尾与立场不一致
model_problems.quote: On balance, therefore, public transport should receive the lion's share of funding, because it tackles congestion at its root and produces broader social and environmental returns that new roads rarely match.
model_problems.comment: 结论未纳入让步段承认的农村与货运例外，使立场表述比引言更绝对，前后略有落差。
model_problems.suggestion: 在结论中补上条件，如 'provided that targeted road upgrades for rural areas and freight are funded separately'。

original_evidence: I am convinced that investment should be weighted decisively towards public transport, with road construction reserved for cases where no realistic alternative exists.
Rural communities and freight logistics depend on reliable highways, and in such contexts targeted upgrades may represent genuine value for money.

On balance, therefore, public transport should receive the lion's share of funding, because it tackles congestion at its root and produces broader social and environmental returns that new roads rarely match.
manual_findings.reason: lion's share表示大部分而非全部资金，rarely也非绝对否定道路，结尾不重述例外不等于撤销例外。模型position.consistent=true，结尾段comment明确写结论与立场一致，却同时给conclusion_inconsistent问题，存在直接内部冲突。

manual_findings.finding: 识别在线教育作文没有回答交通投资题

model_problems.label: 包含与论证无关的内容
model_problems.quote: Online learning has grown rapidly over the past decade, and many people now believe that it will eventually replace traditional classrooms.
model_problems.comment: 全文主题与题目（政府投资公共交通 vs 修建新路）完全不符，属于严重跑题。
model_problems.suggestion: 立即重写全文，围绕公共交通投资与道路建设的利弊展开，确保每段都出现题目关键词。

model_problems.label: 分论点偏离立场或题目
model_problems.quote: The most obvious benefit of online learning is flexibility.
model_problems.comment: 主体段论点与题目要求无关，无法为任何立场提供支撑。
model_problems.suggestion: 改为讨论公共交通的优势，如 'Investing in public transport reduces congestion and pollution more effectively than building new roads.'

model_problems.label: 分论点偏离立场或题目
model_problems.quote: However, classroom learning provides things that are difficult to replicate on a screen.
model_problems.comment: 让步段没有回应'修建新路'一方的论点，让步对象错误。
model_problems.suggestion: 让步段应承认新建道路在货运或偏远地区的必要性，然后反驳并回到支持公共交通的立场。

model_problems.label: 分论点偏离立场或题目
model_problems.quote: In conclusion, online learning is a valuable supplement that makes education more accessible and flexible
model_problems.comment: 结论虽与自身立场一致，但总结的是错误话题，无法与题目立场对应。
model_problems.suggestion: 结论应重申：政府应优先投资公共交通，同时在有需要时适度修建道路。

original_evidence: Online learning has grown rapidly over the past decade, and many people now believe that it will eventually replace traditional classrooms.
In my view, although online courses offer clear advantages, face-to-face education will remain essential.
manual_findings.reason: 题干要求公共交通与道路投资，全文实际讨论在线学习和课堂。离题判断有明确文本依据；立场自身一致与相对题目离题两者可同时成立，模型在这里有正确区分。

manual_findings.finding: 展开不足有依据，强制让步反驳仍偏机械

model_problems.label: 论点缺少解释或支撑
model_problems.quote: It is also cheaper for students and old people who do not have cars.
model_problems.comment: 只给出断言，没有解释低价公交如何支持“政府应优先投资公交”的立场。
model_problems.suggestion: 补充机制与例子：低价票让低收入者能通勤，减少购车需求，如某城市地铁票价补贴后私家车出行下降。

model_problems.label: 论点缺少解释或支撑
model_problems.quote: buses and trains produce less pollution than private cars
model_problems.comment: 环保理由未被展开，缺少数据或具体例子支撑。
model_problems.suggestion: 加入具体说明，例如一辆满载公交车的人均排放远低于同等人数的私家车，并回扣到政府投资公交可改善空气质量。

model_problems.label: 让步后没有反驳
model_problems.quote: However, new roads are still useful in the countryside, where there are not many buses.
model_problems.comment: 让步提出后没有反驳，读者不清楚为何最终仍应优先公交。
model_problems.suggestion: 立即反驳：乡村道路可由地方小预算维护，而全国性的拥堵与排放问题更需集中投资公交。

model_problems.label: 过度概括
model_problems.quote: so it reduces traffic jams in big cities
model_problems.comment: “减少大城市拥堵”是笼统概括，未说明条件（如班次密度、覆盖率）。
model_problems.suggestion: 限定条件：只有在班次频繁、覆盖广时，公交才能有效分流通勤者，从而缓解拥堵。

original_evidence: Public transport can carry many people at the same time, so it reduces traffic jams in big cities.
However, new roads are still useful in the countryside, where there are not many buses.
In conclusion, public transport should be the priority, but some roads are still necessary.
manual_findings.reason: 97词原稿观点非常简短，展开不足和增加条件/例证的建议合理。但公交优先与乡村道路例外仍一致，未逐句反驳例外不是必然错误。载客量→减少拥堵已有简短机制，不能说完全没有机制；应区别机制简单与机制缺失。

manual_findings.finding: 建议加入未附来源的精确排放比例
manual_findings.model_suggestion: 补充具体例证或数据化对比，如："A full bus can cut emissions per person by over 80% compared with the same number of cars."
manual_findings.automated_fact: The model proposes over 80%; this percentage does not appear in the original essay. No source accompanies it.
manual_findings.reason: 不能把这种建议当作已核实的事实直接加入作文。本次没有验证该比例的外部真实性，所以不宣称数字必然错误；应改用有依据的机制说明、明确的假设情境，或先核实数据出处。

assessment: Data-shape and quotation checks passed, but argument judgment quality is not ready to be treated as reliable feedback without teacher review. Strong sample sanity failure reflects substantive false-positive concerns, not merely an overly tight issue-count threshold.
prompt_causality: Inference only: the prompt requires claim->mechanism->example->result, rebuttal after concessions, and reflecting every problem in TR/CC bands. Observed comments repeatedly demand those forms even where a bounded stance or causal explanation already supports the argument. No controlled A/B test was run, so the prompt is a plausible cause rather than a proven sole cause.
next_steps: Treat mechanisms, examples, comparisons and qualified reasoning as alternative support forms; absence of a named city/statistic is not by itself an unsupported argument.
Judge stance consistency over the whole essay; distinguish a genuine contradiction from a bounded exception, and require opposing passage pairs for inconsistency claims.
Allow a concession that defines the scope of the chosen position; demand rebuttal only when an opposing argument actually defeats or weakens that position.
Check agreement among position.consistent, paragraph verdict/comment and issue types; semantic conflicts should be surfaced rather than silently kept.
Bind paragraph maps to actual paragraph identifiers, or explicitly name the output rhetorical units rather than paragraphs.
Use these existing outputs as offline regressions; do not weaken the strong-sample sanity threshold solely to make this batch pass.

Do not invent a precise percentage or real-world study/city outcome merely to satisfy the example slot; use supported mechanisms or clearly hypothetical examples, and verify any specific factual claim before recommending it.
